ux.lcopya.glossary.mcp: A connected tool lets a bot use another app, like a calendar or a database.
ux.lcopya.glossary.acp: The common language Murage uses to talk to AI apps on this computer.
ux.lcopya.glossary.api: The way one program asks another program for something.
ux.lcopya.glossary.apiKey: A private code from an AI company that lets Murage use your account.
ux.lcopya.glossary.byok: You use a key from your own AI account, so the work runs on that account.
ux.lcopya.glossary.token: AI services count text in small pieces; 1,000 of them is about 750 words.
ux.lcopya.glossary.path: Where a file or folder sits on this computer, like Documents/Reports.
ux.lcopya.glossary.cli: An AI app you installed that Murage starts for your bots.
ux.lcopya.glossary.json: A settings file a program reads. You rarely need to open one.
ux.lcopya.glossary.yaml: A settings file a program reads. You rarely need to open one.
ux.lcopya.glossary.config: The settings a program reads when it starts.
ux.lcopya.glossary.oauth: You sign in on the service's own page; Murage never sees your password.
ux.lcopya.glossary.provider: The company whose AI does the work, like OpenAI or Anthropic.
ux.lcopya.glossary.endpoint: The web address a program sends its requests to.
ux.lcopya.glossary.modelId: The exact name a service uses for one of its AI models.
ux.lcopya.glossary.schema: The shape the information has to be in.
ux.lcopya.glossary.payload: The information another app sent along with its request.
ux.lcopya.glossary.webhook: A private web address another app calls to start work for a bot.
ux.lcopya.glossary.stdout: What a program printed while it ran.
ux.lcopya.glossary.stderr: The problems a program printed while it ran.
ux.lcopya.glossary.exitCode: A number a program leaves when it stops; anything but zero means a problem.
ux.lcopya.glossary.sandbox: A closed-off space where a bot's work cannot reach the rest of your computer.
ux.lcopya.glossary.daemon: A helper program that keeps running in the background.
ux.lcopya.glossary.runtime: The software a program needs installed to run.
ux.lcopya.glossary.env: A setting a program reads when it starts.
ux.lcopya.glossary.localhost: An address that means this computer, not the internet.
ux.lcopya.glossary.port: A numbered door a program listens on, on this computer.
ux.lcopya.glossary.ssh: A secure way for Murage to reach and work on your own server.
ux.lcopya.glossary.regex: A text pattern used to find matching words.
ux.lcopya.glossary.repo: A folder of code with its full history of changes.
ux.lcopya.glossary.commit: One saved change in a code project's history.
ux.lcopya.glossary.httpCode: A number a web service sends back about a request, shown only in details.
